findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_simulation_model, check_account_and_credits, send_feedback, create_result_share_link · Private data: rank_inputs_by_impact, get_simulation_results, check_account_and_credits, send_feedback, buy_credits, create_result_share_link, save_graph, list_graphs, get_graph, delete_graph, delete_run · Public sink: run_monte_carlo_simulation, convert_distribution_to_range, check_account_and_credits, send_feedback, buy_credits, create_result_share_link, save_graph, list_graphs, get_graph, delete_graph, delete_run · Destructive: run_monte_carlo_simulation, rank_inputs_by_impact, summarize_outcome_scenarios, check_simulation_model, estimate_simulation_size_and_cost, get_simulation_results, check_account_and_credits, buy_credits, create_result_share_link, save_graph, get_graph, delete_graph, delete_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_simulation_model, check_account_and_credits, send_feedback, create_result_share_link · Private data: rank_inputs_by_impact, get_simulation_results, check_account_and_credits, send_feedback, buy_credits, create_result_share_link, save_graph, list_graphs, get_graph, delete_graph, delete_run · Public sink: run_monte_carlo_simulation, convert_distribution_to_range, check_account_and_credits, send_feedback, buy_credits, create_result_share_link, save_graph, list_graphs, get_graph, delete_graph, delete_run · Destructive: run_monte_carlo_simulation, rank_inputs_by_impact, summarize_outcome_scenarios, check_simulation_model, estimate_simulation_size_and_cost, get_simulation_results, check_account_and_credits, buy_credits, create_result_share_link, save_graph, get_graph, delete_graph, delete_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
